source.repro: The last 400 non-merge commits on main as of 116cc66d41; the 263 that touched a .ts/.tsx/.js/.jsx file still present at that commit, test files excluded. One recorded full run (2136 suites, JEST_MAX_WORKERS=4, nice 15, on battery at load ~10-25) supplied each suite's footprint and its wall time (endTime - startTime from --json). Per commit, each strategy's selected suites are summed by that wall time. 'static' is @jest/core SearchSource.findRelatedTests over the commit's files in one process; 'static, no web' drops products/jbrowse-web unless the commit touched it, which is what test-related did before footprints. 'footprint' selects suites whose footprint holds a changed file; 'footprint + compile filter' first drops files whose @babel/preset-typescript output (comments: false, compact) is identical at C^ and C.
source.notes: Graph and footprints are at 116cc66d41 while the commits are historical, so a file's importers are today's rather than the commit's. Suite-seconds are contended 4-worker times, ~1.3x a quiet box. Over all 263 commits the footprint picked exactly one suite the static graph did not. The distribution is bimodal: ~40% of commits touch a module every app-level suite executes at import (render-core marks, a plugin index, a config schema) and still select most of them. Function-level selection off V8 precise coverage was measured and declined: it added ~27% to every run and moved the mean from 441 to 415, because most changed lines in those modules are top-level.
